final_message:
Generated the DNS hierarchy without altering topology, IPs, or routes.

- Added 13 authoritative BIND zones on pc1–pc13, with all 12 requested delegations and glue records.
- Configured service, web, and MX/A records using the machines’ existing IP addresses.
- Configured pc14 as a recursive resolver rooted at pc1.
- Pointed pc16–pc20 to pc14 via `/etc/resolv.conf`.
- Updated assigned server startup scripts to install BIND if necessary and launch `named`.

Key configuration files are under the new `pcN/etc/bind/` directories, e.g. [root zone](pc1/etc/bind/db.root) and [recursive resolver config](pc14/etc/bind/named.conf). Static verification confirms 13 master zones, 12 delegation records, 14 DNS daemon launchers, and five client resolver configurations.
